dispatch_census_qualification: Existing Id dispatch-metrics feature in separate prefix, untimed. Four warm decoder calls, GC then autoGC off. Control returns input without decoder. Counts include assignment/end-census overhead. Named jsonUnescape send can be bypassed by prepared-call entry; totals are not a named method subtree and counts are not CPU percentages.

full.qualification: Warmed process released through ready/stdin handshake; separate from timings. Includes loop and between-pass GC overhead. Only collapsed leaf symbols with >=5 samples; hash totals are lower bounds. Generated code is not fully symbolized.

unescape.qualification: Warmed process released through ready/stdin handshake; separate from timings. Includes loop and between-pass GC overhead. Only collapsed leaf symbols with >=5 samples; hash totals are lower bounds. Generated code is not fully symbolized.

phases.qualification: Independent warmed phases with prepared inputs retained; not additive attribution. Timing mode retains normal GC. Allocation mode disables automatic GC for one measured pass; its time is not the timing baseline.

sampling_driver_source:
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,os,select,json
base=Path('/tmp/birnam-cpu-20261011');binary='/tmp/birnam-selector-tables/candidate-prefix/bin/birnam';project=base/'work/examples/log-summary/profile';env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith('BIRNAM_')}
for phase in ['full','unescape']:
 p=subprocess.Popen([binary,'run',str(project),'--','/tmp/birnam-selector-tables/acceptance/data/small.jsonl',phase,'5','sample'],cwd=base,env=env,stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
 try:
  assert select.select([p.stdout],[],[],45)[0], 'ready timeout'
  ready=p.stdout.readline();assert ready==b'ready\n',(ready,p.poll())
  with (base/(phase+'-sample.log')).open('wb') as log:
   sampler=subprocess.Popen(['/usr/bin/sample',str(p.pid),'5','1','-file',str(base/(phase+'.sample.txt'))],stdout=log,stderr=log)
   p.stdin.write(b'\n');p.stdin.flush();assert sampler.wait(timeout=25)==0
  out,err=p.communicate(timeout=40);assert p.returncode==0 and not err,(p.returncode,out[-1000:],err)
  (base/(phase+'-sample-result.json')).write_bytes(out);print(phase,'sampled',flush=True)
 finally:
  if p.poll() is None:p.kill();p.communicate()
